id: 192_激光焊机与切割机架的安装
title: 激光焊机与切割机架的安装
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/192_激光焊机与切割机架的安装.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/192_激光焊机与切割机架的安装/src.py

points.K10: 首次开机先看安全培训

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机包装箱和机架包装箱前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two unopened shipping crates, one small and one large on a pallet, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十课：激光焊机与切割机架的安装。
overlay: 激光焊机与切割机架的安装

shots.scene: 阿杰一个人想把焊机主机从箱里抱出来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to lift a heavy welder unit out of a crate alone, his back bent, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：我一个人搬出来就行！

shots.scene: 老李过来抬另一边，指着说明书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes the other side of the unit and points to an open installation manual, a two person lift icon.
shots.narration: 老李：两人抬，照说明书一步步装。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank acceptance checklist and a power off icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：接电接气，交给专业人员。

shots.scene: 焊机可手持也可装进机架
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a handheld laser welder used by hand on one side and its head mounted in a cutting frame on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 焊机能手持用，也能装进切割机架。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four step icons in a row, a crate, a wrench, a wire spool and a weld bead. No text.
shots.narration: 顺序：开箱、安装、送丝、使用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: arrows and icons printed on a crate showing to open the top first and then remove the sleeve sideways. No text.
shots.narration: 先看箱上提示，开顶盖，侧拉外箱。

shots.scene: 【实拍】对照清单逐件清点附件
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands laying out accessories from an opened crate on a table and ticking them off a blank packing list.
shots.narration: 对照物品清单，逐件清点。

shots.scene: 防护眼镜、耐热手套、喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pair of laser safety glasses, heat resistant gloves, a manual, cotton swabs, keys, test plates and several nozzles. No text.
shots.narration: 防护眼镜、手套、说明书、喷嘴、钥匙。

shots.scene: 焊接清洗切割各有喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three different nozzles each linked to welding, cleaning and cutting icons. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接、清洗、切割，各有专用喷嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged part and a missing part icon recorded on an acceptance form sent to the equipment office. No text.
shots.narration: 缺件破损，拍照记录，报设备管理。

shots.scene: 建档、规程上墙、授权使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an equipment file folder, an operating procedure poster on the wall and an authorized user badge. No text.
shots.narration: 验收建档，规程上墙，授权才能用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding head lifted out of its foam cut out first, then the foam removed. No text.
shots.narration: 先取焊接头，再拿掉泡沫。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student lift the welder unit off the pallet together with straight backs.
shots.narration: 主机很重，两人一起抬下托盘。

shots.scene: 线缆不急弯，绕好挂侧面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long cable coiled in a large loop and hung on the side of the unit, a sharp kink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线缆别急弯，绕大圈挂在侧面。

shots.scene: 正面：屏幕急停钥匙孔接口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the front of a welder unit with a blank touch screen, an emergency stop button, a key switch and connectors. No text.
shots.narration: 正面有屏幕、急停、钥匙孔和接口。

shots.scene: 侧面保护气入口，背面电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shielding gas inlet on the side, a power switch and wire feeder sockets on the back. No text.
shots.narration: 侧面进气口，背面电源和送丝接口。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feeder with feed and retract buttons, a wire spool and a drive roller. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝机有送丝、回抽键和丝盘。

shots.scene: 通风、远离易燃物、不挡通道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder placed in a ventilated bay away from flammable items, an exit route kept clear. No text.
shots.narration: 位置要通风，远离易燃物，不挡通道。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder unit with clear space in front and behind, airflow arrows through its vents. No text.
shots.narration: 前后留足散热间隙，散热口不能挡。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a foot pressing down the lock lever on each of the four casters of a powered off welder unit.
shots.narration: 放平后，四个脚轮都要锁住。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water cooler being filled with coolant to the level mark, a manual icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 水冷型按说明书加冷却液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】保护气管插进主机入口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands pushing a gas hose into the shielding gas inlet of a powered off welder, no gas flowing.
shots.narration: 随附气管一端插进主机进气口。

shots.scene: 另一端接气瓶或制气机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the other end of the hose connected to a gas cylinder regulator or a gas generator. No text.
shots.narration: 另一端接气瓶或制气机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas type chosen from the manual and the material, two different cylinders mixed together crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用哪种气看说明书，不随意换不混接。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an empty training gas cylinder standing upright and secured to a wall bracket with a chain.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立放稳，用链条固定。

shots.scene: 远离热源，减压阀按规程装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder away from heat and sparks, a regulator fitted by a trained person, a leak check with soapy water. No text.
shots.narration: 远离火花热源，减压阀按规程装。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch holder assembled from a base plate, a bracket and screws with a hex key. No text.
shots.narration: 用随附工具组装焊枪支架。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding torch resting in its holder, a torch lying on the floor crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊枪不用时放回支架上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a work clamp cable plugged into its socket on the front panel. No text.
shots.narration: 工件感应线插进对应接口。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nameplate on the back of the unit with voltage and power icons, a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 接电前，先看铭牌上的电源要求。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dedicated circuit from the distribution board with a protective earth symbol and a residual current device. No text.
shots.narration: 用容量足够的独立回路，可靠接地。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer with an electrician badge wires a supply connection while a student stands back, a student wiring icon crossed out.
shots.narration: 需要硬接线，由持证电工完成。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round industrial plug aligned with its key upward, pushed in and the locking ring tightened. No text.
shots.narration: 圆形插头对准方向，插到位旋紧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an emergency stop button rotated and popping up into the released position. No text.
shots.narration: 开机前，旋转急停让它弹起。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a key inserted into the key switch, then the rear power switch turned on. No text.
shots.narration: 插好钥匙，打开背面电源开关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a touch screen with a language globe icon and a unit icon being selected. No text.
shots.narration: 屏幕上先选语言和单位。

shots.section_title: 首次开机先看安全培训
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank code square on the screen, a phone playing a safety training video. No text.
shots.narration: 首次开机，先看完安全培训视频。
overlay: 首次开机先看安全培训

shots.section_title: 首次开机先看安全培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator completes the initial setup on the screen while students wait, a padlock icon on the record book.
shots.narration: 初始化和解锁由设备管理员负责。

shots.section_title: 首次开机先看安全培训
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maker training video icon plus a school training certificate, both needed before using. No text.
shots.narration: 厂家培训之外，学校准入也要过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a settings screen showing a focus reference icon beside a scale tube on the welding head. No text.
shots.narration: 在设置里查焦距参考值。

shots.scene: 【实拍】核对焊接头刻度管，推拉调整
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands checking the scale tube on a disconnected welding head, opening the clip and sliding it to a mark.
shots.narration: 对照刻度管，不一致就松扣推拉。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flow meter fitted on a cylinder regulator, a manual icon. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶上先装好流量计。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser enable switch shown off with a checkmark, then a cylinder valve opened slowly. No text.
shots.narration: 确认出光关闭，再慢慢开瓶阀。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing the grip button so gas flows from the nozzle, the flow meter adjusted to the manual value. No text.
shots.narration: 按键通气，按说明书调好流量。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas flow icon first and a laser icon second, a cracked lens icon when welding without gas. No text.
shots.narration: 没气就焊，焊不好还伤镜片。

shots.scene: 【实拍】工件放金属台，工件夹夹在工件上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands clamping a work clamp onto a steel test plate on a metal welding table, the welder powered off.
shots.narration: 工件放金属台，夹子夹在工件上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a work clamp attached to the welding torch scale tube, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 严禁把夹子夹在焊枪上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: feed and retract buttons moving the wire so its tip lands exactly on a red aiming dot. No text.
shots.narration: 用送丝回抽键，让丝尖对准红光点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a red dot off centre and blurred, a calibration icon. No text.
shots.narration: 红光偏了或看不清，先校准。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feed enable switch on the torch turned on. No text.
shots.narration: 打开焊枪上的送丝使能开关。

shots.scene: 屏幕选模式材料厚度丝径
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screen with blank icon tiles for welding mode, material, thickness and wire diameter. No text.
shots.narration: 选焊接模式、材料、厚度和丝径。

shots.scene: 戴好对应波长的防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on laser safety glasses rated for the welder wavelength, a welding screen around the bay.
shots.narration: 开出光前，戴好对应波长的防护镜。

shots.scene: 四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扳机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four numbered icons, enable on the screen, nozzle touching the work, grip button with a green light, trigger pulled. No text.
shots.narration: 使能，贴合工件，按握持键，扣扳机。

shots.scene: 对齐工件，喷嘴对准起点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two plates held in a fixture, the nozzle placed on the start of the seam, hands away from the plates. No text.
shots.narration: 夹具固定工件，喷嘴对准起点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two tack welds at both ends of a seam. No text.
shots.narration: 先点焊两端固定，再焊整条缝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch pushed back by recoil and guided steadily along the seam, pressing down causing a stuck wire crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有反推力，稳住引方向，别下压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a designated laser welding area with curtains, fume extraction and a fire extinguisher, an authorized badge. No text.
shots.narration: 只在指定焊接区，授权后操作。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a just welded part and the torch tip glowing with heat waves, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊完工件和焊枪头很烫，别空手碰。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire feed and laser enable icons switched off during a pause. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停时，关闭送丝和出光。

shots.scene: 关电关气挂焊枪交钥匙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cylinder valve closed, the power switched off, the torch hung on its holder and the key returned. No text.
shots.narration: 做完关光关气关机，拔钥匙交回。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tidies the welding bay and fills in a blank equipment use log.
shots.narration: 清理现场，填写使用记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large crate on a pallet with ample free floor space marked around it. No text.
shots.narration: 机架开箱前，四周留出足够空地。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the front panel of the crate unlatched and lowered to form a ramp, then side and back panels removed. No text.
shots.narration: 开前板搭扣，前板放下当坡道。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: only the base pallet left, accessories laid out and ticked off a list. No text.
shots.narration: 拆左右后板，对照清单清点配件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: straps cut off and levelling feet wound up with a wrench. No text.
shots.narration: 拆绑带，用扳手旋起调平脚。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and two students roll the frame slowly down the ramp, one holding back to control speed.
shots.narration: 下坡有惯性，多人慢慢控速。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a wrench lowering a levelling foot of a machine frame onto the floor and tightening the lock nut, a spirit level on top.
shots.narration: 推到位放下调平脚，调平锁紧螺母。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: transport bars at the base corners removed, the screws kept in a small tray. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下底角固定杆，螺丝留好备用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crank handle raising the machine body, an eye level view aligning a white line with the base beam. No text.
shots.narration: 用摇杆升主机，平视白线齐底梁。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four long bars fitted with screws loosely first, then all tightened, a short bar shown with its direction arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 四根先装上，再一起拧紧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: side panels slid into slots and screwed, then front and back panels fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 侧板对槽推入，前后板依次装好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottom tray pushed into its slot and filled with sand or water to a moderate level. No text.
shots.narration: 底板加适量沙或水，隔热防变形。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an exhaust fan with its arrow pointing up, plugged in and pressed onto locating pins. No text.
shots.narration: 排风扇箭头朝上，插头接好压到位。

shots.scene: 【实拍】排烟管卡箍拧紧，接到净化器
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a screwdriver tightening a hose clamp on a fume duct between a powered off machine and a fume purifier.
shots.narration: 排烟管卡箍拧紧，接到净化器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small antenna and a hanging hook fitted to the frame. No text.
shots.narration: 再装好天线和挂钩。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: both the welder and the frame switched off and unplugged, a lockout tag on the plugs. No text.
shots.narration: 装焊接头、接线前，两台都断电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand plugging a communication cable into a live machine, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不带电插拔线缆，不开盖改线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a communication cable connected at both ends and the screw collars tightened. No text.
shots.narration: 通信线两头接好，旋紧。

shots.scene: 取出运输螺栓，换切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid opened, three transport bolts removed, the welding nozzle swapped for a cutting nozzle. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖取出运输螺栓，换上切割嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding head placed on locating pins of the carriage and the latch closed. No text.
shots.narration: 对准销钉装上滑架，合上搭扣。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cable straightened and clipped so it stays clear of the guide rail. No text.
shots.narration: 线缆理直卡好，不能碰导轨。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welder and the frame each plugged into its own earthed socket. No text.
shots.narration: 两台设备分别接电，都要接地。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two emergency stop buttons released and two keys inserted. No text.
shots.narration: 两台急停都释放，插好钥匙。

shots.scene: 接气：气瓶或空压机加干燥机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas supply from a secured cylinder, or from an air compressor followed by an air dryer. No text.
shots.narration: 接气：气瓶，或空压机加干燥机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a valve opened as the manual shows, then the two machines switched on one after the other. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明开阀，两台依次开机。

shots.scene: 清点验收、两人抬放、锁脚轮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ticked packing list, a two person lift and a locked caster icon. No text.
shots.narration: 清点验收，两人抬放，锁好脚轮。

shots.scene: 电工接电接地，气瓶固定，先通气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician badge with an earth symbol, a chained cylinder and a gas flow icon before a laser icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电工接电接地，气瓶固定，先通气。

shots.scene: 断电装机，戴镜焊接，焊后防烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unplugged machine, laser safety glasses and a hot part with a glove icon. No text.
shots.narration: 断电安装，戴镜焊接，焊后防烫。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一块焊好的钢板样件
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small steel sample with a neat weld bead, standing beside a closed laser cutting frame, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光焊接与切割工艺。
